graph_kind: tracked-file inventory and static syntax navigation graph
limitations: Static syntax and declared imports only; not a full or runtime call graph.
Python import edges are syntactic occurrences, including conditional, TYPE_CHECKING, and nested imports. Import execution and installed dependency availability are not checked.

Python import-symbol and inheritance resolution uses direct lexical/name matches only. Re-exports, dynamic imports, monkey-patching, dispatch, decorator effects and runtime-generated definitions may remain unresolved.
JavaScript uses Tree-sitter syntax; dynamic import/require expressions without literal targets remain unresolved. Embedded HTML script blocks are included.
Bash functions and source expressions are indexed; sourced targets are not evaluated. Embedded heredoc programs and documentation code blocks are not treated as repository source files.
Markdown headings and local links use a documented heuristic. Remaining formats retain complete file metadata; JSON, JSONL, TOML and YAML receive syntax validation only.
